title: 6.1 Exponential Growth and Decay Functions

icans: I can identify and evaluate exponential functions.
I can tell exponential growth from decay and find the percent rate of change.
I can write and use exponential models, including compound interest.

vocab: a line a graph gets __________ and closer to; for y = abˣ it is y = 0
y = a(1 + r)ᵗ  /  y = a(1 − r)ᵗ, where r is the __________ rate as a decimal

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Exponential function: An exponential function has the form y = _______________, where a ≠ 0, b > 0, and b ≠ 1.

blocks.stem: Evaluate y = 4(3)ˣ for x = −2 and x = 2.

notes: Growth or decay: If b > 1, the function shows exponential _______________. If 0 < b < 1, it shows exponential _______________.
Asymptote: The graph of y = abˣ has a horizontal asymptote at _______________.

blocks.stem:
